Our Leadership

GLOBAL PASTOR

Louie + Shelley Giglio

Louie is the Visionary Architect and Director of the Passion Movement, and the founder of Passion Institute. Shelley is the Chief Strategist, Director of Label Operations and Artist Management for sixstepsrecords, co-founder of the Passion Movement, and leads The GROVE, a gathering for the girls of Atlanta.
SEE OUR LEADERSHIP

WASHINGTON DC CITY PASTOR

Ben and Donna Stuart

Ben Stuart is the pastor of Passion City Church, Washington D.C. Prior to joining Passion City Church, Ben served as the executive director of Breakaway Ministries on the campus of Texas A&M. Ben earned a master’s degree in historical theology from Dallas Theological Seminary.
SEE OUR LEADERSHIP

ATLANTA CITY PASTOR

Brad + Brittany Jones

Our 515 Location in Atlanta is pastored by Brad Jones. Together, he and his wife Brittany have been a part of the Passion Movement for over a decade helping carry the heartbeat of Passion Conference and Passion City Church. They live in Atlanta with their two children, Caleb and Addy.
SEE OUR LEADERSHIP

CUMBERLAND LOCATION PASTOR

Jonathan + Mary Pickens

Jonathan Pickens serves as the Cumberland Location Pastor at Passion City Church. He is passionate about helping people know, follow, and enjoy Jesus. Jonathan graduated from the University of Georgia and holds a Master’s in Historical Theology from Dallas Theological Seminary. He and his wife, Mary, live in Marietta with their two daughters, Rae and Merit. Together, Jonathan and Mary love building the church.
SEE OUR LEADERSHIP

TRILITH LOCATION PASTOR

Dan + Jo Watson

Dan Watson serves as the Location Pastor at our Passion City Church @ Trilith Location in Atlanta. Dan is passionate about raising up leaders and inspiring people to live wholeheartedly for the things of God. He and Jo have been married for 16 years and have four beautiful children. Dan and Jo are originally from London where they pastored for 10 years before relocating to Atlanta.
SEE OUR LEADERSHIP

Knowing God Above All Else

Passion Equip

Passion Equip exists to see people in our House and around the globe know and draw closer to Jesus. This is an incredible tool for everyone in our House to engage with God each and every day through the Truth of His Word.

Learn More
Giving

We believe Jesus is a giver and not a taker. Not only has He given us life and breath, but by His death and resurrection, He defeated the sin that would rob us of both. So, when it comes to giving, we believe percentages are a thing of the past, and obligation is the wrong approach.

Giving is worship—and our worship is a response to the extravagant grace and glory of God.
